summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill aims to increase public trust in the Commonwealth Parliament by helping it prevent and resolve its own integrity problems.
It would create statutory codes of conduct for parliamentarians and their staff, establish a Parliamentary Integrity Advisor and a Parliamentary Standards Commissioner to handle alleged breaches.
The bill is part of a larger package that also includes the National Integrity Commission Bill 2018.
changes: Creates statutory codes of conduct for members of each parliamentary house and their staff.
Establishes a Parliamentary Integrity Advisor to give independent advice on the codes.
Sets up a Parliamentary Standards Commissioner to assist in investigating and resolving code breaches.
Provides a statutory basis for parliamentarians' registers of interests.
summary.affected: Members of the Commonwealth Parliament and their staff.

speeches.speaker: Cathy McGowan
speeches.brief: The speaker moved the National Integrity (Parliamentary Standards) Bill 2018, which establishes a code of conduct for parliamentarians, a Parliamentary Integrity Adviser, and a Parliamentary Standards Commissioner, and urged the government to adopt the package of integrity reforms.

speeches.speaker: Rebekha Sharkie
speeches.brief: The speaker seconded the National Integrity (Parliamentary Standards) Bill 2018, arguing that public distrust in parliament is driven by misconduct such as $38,000 internet expenses, free flights and gifts, and urged the government and opposition to support the bill to restore integrity.
